# Amplitude

Amplitude gives you the self-serve tools and real-time data to make products and experiences that win no matter what.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/amplitude/.

## Actions

- **Check Amplitude Cohort Status** (read-only): Check the status of a cohort export request.
- **List Amplitude Cohorts** (read-only): List all discoverable cohorts for an amplitude project.
- **Request Amplitude Cohort** (read-only): Get a single cohort by id and initiate download.
- **Send Events to Amplitude**: Send events to amplitude using the http v2 api.
- **Update User Properties in Amplitude**: Update user properties using amplitude's identify api.
- **Create Amplitude Event Category**: Create a new event category in amplitude.
- **Create Amplitude Event Type**: Create a new event type in amplitude.
- **Delete Amplitude Event Category**: Delete an event category from amplitude.
- **Delete Amplitude Event Type**: Delete an event type from amplitude.
- **Get Amplitude Event Categories** (read-only): Get event categories from amplitude.
- **Get Amplitude Event Type** (read-only): Get a specific event type from amplitude by name.
- **Get Amplitude Event Types** (read-only): Get all event types from amplitude.
- **Restore Amplitude Event Type**: Restore a deleted event type in amplitude.
- **Update Amplitude Cohort Membership**: Incrementally update cohort membership by adding or removing ids.
- **Update Amplitude Event Category**: Update an existing event category in amplitude.
- **Update Amplitude Event Type**: Update an existing event type in amplitude.
